novels.art_style_notes: Monumental Avengers-event double-page splash compositions: all six CoSE heroes united across golden-hour lunar bio-domes, glowing 4K BioSim blueprints, and deep starry frontiers.
big_finds: NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Models fuse optical, elevation, and thermal layers to map crater water ice, solar peaks of eternal light, and regolith hazards before construction.

Serious simulations (Lunar Sims, Settlers of the Moon, Lunar Red Alert) prove the core law of lunar urban planning: balancing 14-day freezing nights, underground sintered-regolith radiation roofs, and supply-chain bottlenecks.

BioSim Next-Gen 4K Digital Twins reveal real-time stoichiometric balance: exercising astronauts exhale CO₂ that airflow-engineered vertical plant racks scrub back into breathable O₂ and food, while Myco recycles every scrap.
CoSE Academy proves students who test hypotheses inside live habitat simulations leap from guesses to true systems-engineering mastery—preparing humanity for both the Moon and Mars!
novels.take_home: We don't conquer space alone—we carry Earth's living circle with us! Humans, plants, fungi, and open science united can turn any barren frontier into a thriving home.
novels.mission_activity: Launch BioSim Next-Gen and LunarSims, design your own Artemis City South Pole base, and keep crew oxygen, calories, water, and power balanced through the 14-day lunar night!

pages.act: Act I — Mapping the South Pole
pages.beat_title: NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Models Scan the Shadows

director.shot: Monumental orbital Marvel crossover opening! Sweeping golden-and-cyan multispectral AI scanning grids drape across jagged Lunar South Pole craters, revealing glowing sapphire water-ice veins beside sunlit ridge peaks.
director.lighting: Stark obsidian crater shadows illuminated by golden solar-peak rims and glowing sapphire ice contours.
director.pacing: Grand cinematic scale—choosing where humanity's first permanent off-world city will rise.
director.data_story_note: Highlights lunar-lfm-explorer (NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model) and LunarSims' fundamental law of lunar urban planning: solar power peaks vs. shadowed crater ice.

caption.k5: THE GRAND FINALE! High above the Moon's South Pole, giant AI satellites peek straight into dark frozen craters—hunting for hidden water ice AND sunny hilltops!
caption.ms: NASA-IBM LUNAR FOUNDATION MODEL. Combining optical, elevation, and thermal layers solves the #1 law of lunar city planning: balancing sunlit solar ridges against crater ice!
caption.hs: MULTISPECTRAL FOUNDATION-MODEL RECONNAISSANCE. Fusing orbital elevation, thermal inertia, and illumination maps locates permanently shadowed water ice beside high-illumination rims.

bubbles.speaker: pixel
bubbles.k5: Target locked! Right on Shackleton Rim: gleaming solar power on the ridge AND ancient frozen water tucked safely inside the dark crater below!
bubbles.ms: LunarSims players learn this rule fast: build too far from sunlight and you freeze; build too far from crater ice and your greenhouse runs dry!
bubbles.hs: Lunar Foundation Model hazard screening clears boulders and slopes—selecting the optimal site for Artemis City's underground sintered domes!

bubbles.speaker: astra
bubbles.k5: Touchdown confirmed! Earth Mission Control, ISS relay, and every phytonaut on board—let's build Artemis City before sunset hits!
bubbles.ms: Wait—look at that giant black shadow creeping across the craters! The 14-day freezing lunar night is rolling in fast!
bubbles.hs: Two weeks of −170°C darkness plus cosmic radiation incoming—time to put every single CoSE breakthrough to the ultimate survival test!

pages.act: Act I — The 14-Day Night Falls
pages.beat_title: Sintered Shields Against Cold and Cosmic Fire

director.shot: High-stakes Marvel event crisis splash! A colossal wave of night shadow sweeps across the lunar plain frosting exterior radiators blue while thick sintered-regolith overhead vaults deflect streaking crimson cosmic rays.
director.lighting: Icy glacial-blue lunar darkness clashing against blazing crimson GCR streaks and warm amber sanctuary light glowing deep beneath the regolith roofs.
director.pacing: Dramatic tension—showing why lunar survival is an unforgiving systems puzzle.
director.data_story_note: Synthesizes Lunar-and-Martian-frontier-game-prototype (14-day energy storage crisis), lunar-arcade (underground regolith radiation shielding), and Lunar_Red_Alert (supply-line bottlenecks).

caption.k5: NIGHT FALLS FOR 336 STRAIGHT HOURS! Outside the domes, temperatures plunge colder than Antarctica—and crimson cosmic rays rain down from deep space!
caption.ms: THE 14-DAY LUNAR NIGHT CRISIS. Unlike Mars's 24-hour day, the Moon demands massive energy storage, underground sintered-regolith roofs, and rock-solid supply chains!
caption.hs: EXTREME LUNAR THERMAL & RADIATION ENVELOPE. Excavating subterranean habitats and piling sintered regolith overhead slashes GCR dose while turning mined rock into ISRU feedstock.

bubbles.speaker: myco
bubbles.k5: Good thing we dug underground and piled baked Moon-brick shielding over our heads! Those nasty cosmic rays bounce right off!
bubbles.ms: Wait—power batteries are dipping while the crew's CO₂ is climbing! If a single link between power, water, and farms breaks, the whole base feels it!
bubbles.hs: Lunar Red Alert taught us the hard truth: supply-line bottlenecks between harvesters, refineries, and power domes dictate survival in a vacuum.

bubbles.speaker: doc-b
bubbles.k5: Don't panic, Artemis City! Earth Mission Control and ISS relay are linked in—open the 4K BioSim Digital Twin right now!
bubbles.ms: Before we touch a single real valve, let's test the fix inside our live BioSim Next-Gen simulator and balance the whole loop!
bubbles.hs: Zero-risk positioning before high-risk action—time to synchronize crew metabolism, airflow towers, and fungal recycling in real time!

pages.act: Act II — Heroes Assemble Around the Digital Twin
pages.beat_title: BioSim Next-Gen: War Room of the Living Loop

director.shot: Iconic Marvel Avengers war-room splash! Commander Astra, full-body holographic Doc B, floating Pixel, glowing Sprout, amber Myco, and violet Statolith gather around a colossal glowing 4K holographic BioSim twin of Artemis City.
director.lighting: Dazzling emerald, sapphire, and golden holographic light illuminating all six heroes' determined faces in a dramatic circular composition.
director.pacing: Team-up adrenaline—every single discovery from Volumes 01–09 slots into place!
director.data_story_note: Synthesizes biosim-nextgen (4K ASTRO-USA Digital Twin) and Settlers_of_the_Moon_or_Mars (ISRU & mycoponics resource trading).

caption.k5: ALL SIX HEROES UNITED! Around the glowing 4K BioSim table, astronauts, phytonauts, and Mission Control combine EVERY secret from our ten adventures!
caption.ms: BIOSIM NEXT-GEN DIGITAL TWIN. Watch the invisible dance live: every breath of crew CO₂, every kilowatt of LED light, every drop of recycled water balanced to the gram!
caption.hs: STOICHIOMETRIC BIOREGENERATIVE CONTROL. Synchronizing human respiratory quotient, vertical-rack photosynthetic O₂ evolution, CFD cross-flow, and mycoponic mineralization.

bubbles.speaker: astra
bubbles.k5: Sprout, dial up your red-and-blue LEDs and gentle fan louvers! Statolith, guide those roots straight down into the sintered ceramic wicks!
bubbles.ms: We're shifting our purple anthocyanin greens and fast microgreens to peak CO₂ scrubbing while Myco converts every scrap of straw into protein and heat!
bubbles.hs: Routing exercising-crew CO₂ straight into the radial plenum racks turns human exertion into rocket fuel for photosynthesis!

bubbles.speaker: doc-b
bubbles.k5: Look at the BioSim curves flattening into pure emerald stability—even thousands of students testing this in CoSE Academy found the exact same winning balance!
bubbles.ms: And Pixel just confirmed our circadian light schedules are synced for BOTH astronauts and crops—flip the switch, Commander!
bubbles.hs: All 9 subsystems verified in simulation: CFD, 0.166g LEAF, multi-omics clocks, quantum coils, calcium sensors, wild crops, mycoponics, and Crew Vital nutrition!

pages.act: Act II — The Living Circle in Full Symphony
pages.beat_title: Cutaway of Artemis City Breathing as One

director.shot: Breathtaking architectural Marvel cross-section cutaway of the entire multi-level Artemis City dome! Top deck: astronauts exercising exhaling glowing cyan CO₂ streams down into radial LED vertical crop towers; lower deck: Myco's golden fungal beds feeding sintered ceramic roots sending shimmering emerald O₂ waves right back up to the crew!
director.lighting: Jewel-like vertical symphony of sapphire water pipes, magenta-emerald crop decks, warm golden mycelial basements, and bright sunlit crew quarters.
director.pacing: Pure visual ecstasy—the entire closed-loop ecosystem understood in one unforgettable glance.
director.data_story_note: The ultimate educational diagram-as-art: synthesizing gas exchange, water recovery, solid-waste mycoponics, nutrition, and crew health in one continuous loop.

caption.k5: BEHOLD THE LIVING CIRCLE! Astronauts breathe out CO₂ that plants love; plants make fresh oxygen and super-veggies for astronauts; Myco turns every scrap back into rich soil!
caption.ms: ONE CLOSED-LOOP SYMPHONY. Airflow fans thin the boundary layers, blue-red LEDs power antioxidants, sintered ceramics hold water, and fungi close the waste loop!
caption.hs: CLOSED-LOOP BIOREGENERATIVE LIFE SUPPORT (BLSS). Zero-waste coupling of human respiration, forced-convection vertical canopies, ISRU ceramics, and mycoponic biomanufacturing.

bubbles.speaker: sprout
bubbles.k5: I breathe in what Astra breathes out, and I send fresh crisp oxygen and juicy tomatoes right back up the stairs! Best circle ever!
bubbles.ms: Every trick we discovered on the ISS and in Earth labs is humming together—no stagnant air, synced clocks, purple shields, thriving roots!
bubbles.hs: Canopy photosynthesis is scrubbing 100% of cabin CO₂ while replenishing potable transpired condensate and fresh phytochemicals!

bubbles.speaker: statolith
bubbles.k5: And down in every root tip, I'm still tumbling gently in 1/6th gravity to keep the garden pointing home!
bubbles.ms: Not a single gram of carbon or drop of water escapes the circle—Artemis City is breathing on its own!
bubbles.hs: Night 14 of 14... thermal reserves holding steady, oxygen 21%, crew biomarkers peak green—look to the eastern ridge!

pages.act: Act III — Dawn Over the South Pole
pages.beat_title: Surviving the Night, Welcoming the Sun

director.shot: Radiant golden-hour Marvel splash! The first blinding rays of lunar sunrise ignite tall solar towers atop Shackleton Rim after 336 hours of darkness, illuminating the glowing emerald and ruby skylight domes of Artemis City.
director.lighting: Blazing molten-gold sunlight piercing razor-black lunar shadows, catching glittering ice frost melting off tower ridges and emerald dome glow below.
director.pacing: Emotional crescendo—victory earned through science, teamwork, and persistence.
director.data_story_note: Celebrates CoSE Academy's educational impact: when learners see systems survive real constraints in simulations, curiosity turns into mastery.

caption.k5: SUNRISE ON THE MOON! After fourteen freezing days of darkness, golden sunlight floods the solar towers—and Artemis City didn't just survive, it BLOOMED!
caption.ms: FIRST LUNAR NIGHT CONQUERED. Solar power surges back to 100%, greenhouses overflow with fresh harvest, and Earth Mission Control erupts in cheers!
caption.hs: MISSION MILESTONE ACHIEVED. Validated closed-loop autonomy proves humanity can sustain living terrestrial ecosystems indefinitely beyond Earth's cradle.

bubbles.speaker: astra
bubbles.k5: Good morning, Sun! Fourteen days of deep lunar night—and we're greeting the dawn with fresh red tomatoes and crisp green salad!
bubbles.ms: Every single failure we simulated back in CoSE Academy saved us out here for real. Play to discover—build to endure!
bubbles.hs: Full solar recharge online, zero crew nutritional deficit, 100% water loop closure. Artemis City is officially open for science!

bubbles.speaker: myco
bubbles.k5: Mmm—fresh breakfast mushrooms are ready too! And look up past blue Earth... see that tiny rusty red star twinkling over there?
bubbles.ms: If we can turn freezing airless Moon dust into a garden, imagine what we can grow when Mars hands us a whole atmosphere of CO₂!
bubbles.hs: Next horizon: Martian CO₂ greenhouses, southern-highland magnetic fields, and multi-year interplanetary voyages!

pages.act: Act III — To Earth, The Moon, and Beyond
pages.beat_title: The Living Bridge to the Stars

director.shot: Unforgettable full-bleed Marvel Crossover Grand Finale! Inside a vast panoramic lunar conservatory dome blooming with tomatoes, wheat, Arabidopsis, and glowing golden mushrooms—Commander Astra, Doc B, Pixel, Sprout, Myco, and Statolith gaze out together toward bright sapphire Earth and distant crimson Mars.
director.lighting: Golden conservatory warmth meeting endless velvet starlight, blue Earthshine, and a distant ruby glint of Mars.
director.pacing: Timeless, inspiring send-off inviting the reader to become the next explorer in the 114-issue archive and live simulators!
director.data_story_note: Directly hands the torch to the reader: explore all 114 underlying open-source projects, launch live tools, and join the open-science frontier.

caption.k5: THE ADVENTURE IS JUST BEGINNING! Everything we learn growing gardens on the ISS and the Moon helps us care even better for our precious blue home, Earth!
caption.ms: FROM ONE TINY SPROUT TO ARTEMIS CITY. Humans, plants, fungi, and open science united—carrying Earth's living circle into the cosmos.
caption.hs: THE COSE OPEN-SCIENCE INVITATION. Every panel in these 10 graphic novels links directly to open code, FAIR NASA OSDR datasets, and live browser simulators—now it's YOUR turn to discover!

bubbles.speaker: doc-b
bubbles.k5: Nature already wrote the greatest playbook in the universe—and now YOU know how to read it! Which live simulator will you launch first?
bubbles.ms: Every discovery we made for the Moon—saving water, understanding air, protecting soil, keeping people healthy—makes life better on Earth too!
bubbles.hs: Jump into the 114-issue Research Archive, spin the Concept Constellation, or open any GitHub repo below—the frontier is wide open!

bubbles.speaker: astra
bubbles.k5: See you among the stars, fellow astronauts, phytonauts, and Mission Control scientists!
bubbles.ms: Earth gave us life. The ISS taught us how it adapts. The Moon taught us how to stay. Next stop: Mars—and beyond!
bubbles.hs: End of Season One of The CoSE Chronicles—dive into the Mission Debrief below to explore every real dataset and simulator behind the story!
